mapper.select: SELECT t.team_cd, t.team_nm, t.rgn_nm, m.mtn_tm_nm AS meetingTime, ta.team_age_name AS teamAge, l.tier AS level, t.is_temp, t.view_cnt, t.favorite_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(team_cd) FROM team_user tu WHERE tu.team_cd = t.team_cd) AS userCount, s.stadium_nm, t.gender, t.act_dow, t.is_deleted FROM team t LEFT JOIN meeting_times m ON t.mtn_tm = m.mtn_tm_cd LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd LEFT JOIN stadium s ON t.stadium = s.stadium_no WHERE t.is_deleted = 0;

SELECT t.team_cd, t.team_nm, t.rgn_nm, m.mtn_tm_nm AS meetingTime, ta.team_age_name AS teamAge, l.tier AS level, t.is_temp, t.view_cnt, t.favorite_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(team_cd) FROM team_user tu WHERE tu.team_cd = t.team_cd) AS userCount, s.stadium_nm AS stadium FROM team t LEFT JOIN meeting_times m ON t.mtn_tm = m.mtn_tm_cd LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd LEFT JOIN stadium s ON t.stadium = s.stadium_no WHERE t.team_nm like CONCAT('%', #{inputParam}, '%');
SELECT p.province_id AS provinceId, p.`name` FROM provinces p ORDER BY p.province_id;
SELECT s.stadium_no AS stadiumNo, s.stadium_nm AS stadiumName, s.stadium_addr AS stadiumAddr, s.province_id AS provinceId FROM stadium s;

SELECT t.team_cd, t.team_nm, t.rgn_nm, m.mtn_tm_nm AS meetingTime, ta.team_age_name AS teamAge, l.tier AS level, t.is_temp, t.view_cnt, t.favorite_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(team_cd) FROM team_user tu WHERE tu.team_cd = t.team_cd) AS userCount, s.stadium_nm, t.gender, t.act_dow FROM team t LEFT JOIN meeting_times m ON t.mtn_tm = m.mtn_tm_cd LEFT JOIN team_age ta ON t.team_age = ta.team_age_cd LEFT JOIN levels l ON t.level_cd = l.level_cd LEFT JOIN stadium s ON t.stadium = s.stadium_no WHERE t.team_cd = #{teamCode};

SELECT u.user_id as userId, u.user_nm as name, u.user_level as level, ta.team_authrt_nm as teamAuthrtName FROM `user` u LEFT JOIN team_user tu ON u.user_id = tu.user_cd LEFT JOIN team_authrt ta ON tu.team_auhrt_cd = ta.team_authrt_cd WHERE tu.team_cd = #{teamCode};
SELECT ts.attack, ts.speed, ts.dribble, ts.stamina, ts.defense, ts.physical, ts.pass, ts.shot FROM team_state ts WHERE team_cd = #{teamCode};

SELECT ts.team_dt_cd AS teamDateCode, ts.team_cd AS teamCode, ts.ttl AS title, ts.plc_nm AS placeName, ts.prnmnt_ymd AS date, ts.bgng_time AS startTime, ts.end_time AS endTime, ts.dtl_cn AS contents, ts.reg_ymd AS registrationDate FROM team_schedules ts WHERE ts.team_cd = #{teamCode};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team( team_cd, team_nm, rgn_nm, mtn_tm, team_age, level_cd, is_temp, stadium, gender, act_dow ) VALUES ( #{teamCode}, #{teamName}, #{regionName}, (SELECT mt.mtn_tm_cd FROM meeting_times mt WHERE mt.mtn_tm_nm = #{meetingTime}), (SELECT ta.team_age_cd FROM team_age ta WHERE ta.team_age_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{teamAge}, '%')), (SELECT l.level_cd FROM levels l WHERE l.tier = #{level}), #{isTemp}, (SELECT s.stadium_no FROM stadium s WHERE s.stadium_nm = #{stadium}), #{gender}, #{activeDoWeek} );

INSERT INTO team_state( team_cd, attack, speed, dribble, stamina, defense, physical, pass, shot ) VALUES ( #{teamCode}, #{attack}, #{speed}, #{dribble}, #{stamina}, #{defense}, #{physical}, #{pass}, #{shot} );

INSERT INTO team_schedules( team_dt_cd, team_cd, ttl, plc_nm, prnmnt_ymd, bgng_time, end_time, dtl_cn, reg_ymd ) VALUES ( ( SELECT CASE WHEN CONVERT(SUBSTRING(team_dt_cd,9), UNSIGNED) + 1 < 100 THEN CONCAT('team_dt_', LPAD(CONVERT(SUBSTRING(team_dt_cd,9), UNSIGNED) + 1, 2, '0')) WHEN CONVERT(SUBSTRING(team_dt_cd,9), UNSIGNED) + 1 >= 100 THEN CONCAT('team_dt_', CONVERT(SUBSTRING(team_dt_cd,9), UNSIGNED) + 1) END FROM (SELECT team_dt_cd FROM team_schedules) AS temp ORDER BY CONVERT(SUBSTRING(team_dt_cd,9), UNSIGNED) DESC LIMIT 1 ), #{teamCode}, #{title}, #{placeName}, #{date}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{contents}, NOW() );

INSERT INTO team_recruit_post( rcrt_aply_cd, team_cd, rcrt_aply_cn, rcrt_aply_dt, file_no, rcrt_team_age, rcrt_gender, rcrt_level, rcrt_team_dvsn ) VALUES ( ( SELECT CASE WHEN CONVERT(SUBSTRING(rcrt_aply_cd,11), UNSIGNED) + 1 < 100 THEN CONCAT('rcrt_aply_', LPAD(CONVERT(SUBSTRING(rcrt_aply_cd,11), UNSIGNED) + 1, 2, '0')) WHEN CONVERT(SUBSTRING(rcrt_aply_cd,11), UNSIGNED) + 1 >= 100 THEN CONCAT('rcrt_aply_', CONVERT(SUBSTRING(rcrt_aply_cd,11), UNSIGNED) + 1) END FROM (SELECT rcrt_aply_cd FROM team_recruit_post) AS temp ORDER BY CONVERT(SUBSTRING(rcrt_aply_cd,11), UNSIGNED) DESC LIMIT 1 ), #{teamCode}, #{contents}, NOW(), NULL, (SELECT ta.team_age_cd FROM team_age ta WHERE ta.team_age_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{age}, '%')), #{gender}, #{level}, #{teamDistinction} );
